Amrita —

Here are the roughs you asked for. One practical thing we noticed on your site that should move CPA: ages show on cards but there’s no quick height/cm cue in the first screen. Add a single height hint and a fit cue (“true to size” or “size up for room‑to‑grow”—whichever your returns data supports) on any paid LP and the related cards.

Ad roughs (ship each in three variants)
1) Mud Wins — playproof bottoms
- Visual: 3–5s clip: muddy knees → quick cut to reinforced knee panel; alt: macro static of stitching with mud flecks; alt: carousel (macro → full outfit → knee panel).
- Hooks to test: “Reinforced knees. Playground proof.” / “Mud’s fine. These survive.” / “Built to be handed down.”
- CTA: Shop playproof bottoms
- Variants: 9:16 video, 4:5 macro static, 1:1 carousel (with/without price overlay).

2) Rain Test — Splash Raincoat + rainwear
- Visual: hose or drizzle beading on fabric; shake‑dry moment; alt: macro still of water beading.
- Hooks: “Dry kids = longer play.” / “Rain on. Play on.” / “Free UK returns.”
- CTA: Get the Splash Raincoat
- Variants: 9:16 clip, 4:5 macro static, 1:1 GIF/loop.

3) Hand‑Me‑Down — longevity/planet
- Visual: sibling hand‑off or year‑1/2/3 stack of the same piece.
- Hooks: “Built to be handed down.” / “Planet‑kind, playproof.” / “GOTS organic cotton.”
- CTA: Shop bestsellers built to last
- Variants: 9:16 video, 1:1 carousel, 4:5 single image.

Landing page wireframes (one ad, one promise, one page)
A) Rough‑and‑Tumble (bottoms)
- Hero: macro knee panel + headline “Reinforced knees. Playground ready.”
- Sub: “GOTS organic cotton. 30‑day free returns.” Primary CTA: Shop playproof bottoms.
- Proof: close‑up panel callouts (stitching, double layer); optional 8–10s loop clip.
- Fit help: age + height/cm hint in first screen; quick size/returns note.
- Social proof: 2 short parent quotes.
- Grid: bottoms only, pre‑filtered to in‑stock sizes; cards show size/height hint.
- FAQ: care, durability, returns.

B) Rain (rainwear)
- Hero: water‑beading macro + “Dry kids = longer play.”
- Sub: “30‑day free returns.” CTA: Get the Splash Raincoat.
- Proof: seams/zip guard detail; optional shake‑dry loop.
- Fit help + quick care note.
- Social proof, grid, brief FAQ as above.

C) Party (bright sets/dresses)
- Hero: twirl/colour pop + “Party‑bright, play‑ready.”
- Sub: “GOTS organic cotton. 30‑day free returns.” CTA: Party‑ready outfits.
- Proof: colourfast/care note; fit cue; grid of party pieces.

How to test (keeps it clean and attributable)
- Map each ad concept only to its matching page; keep a 10% homepage holdout for benchmark.
- Count cost per first order by page. Retire any creative after three weeks of falling click‑through; keep anything still climbing.
- Use your existing Lookbook frames for hero visuals while you capture the short proof clips.

Kids’ apparel case study with numbers
- We don’t have a published kidswear case we can share yet. Closest quantified analogue in our work: Oatside Kitchen (DTC food) cut cost per first order by 38% by moving ads from the homepage to promise‑specific pages. Same testing pattern here: one ad, one promise, one page.
